subject.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-fable-5 to CLI allowlist, aliases, labels, and context window

question: After the alias defect is repaired, should OpenClaw expose Claude Fable 5 through the Claude CLI setup allowlist and static model catalog?
rationale: The context correction is a concrete bug fix, but adding a model to setup defaults and the selectable provider catalog changes user-facing provider policy and requires an owner decision under the repository's compatibility guidance. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/openclaw/main/AGENTS.md))

options.title: Accept broad Fable support
options.body: Repair the alias and merge this PR as the canonical Claude CLI Fable 5 catalog, setup, and context update.

options.title: Keep context handling only
options.body: Narrow this branch to context resolution and omit allowlist, default-seeding, and catalog exposure until provider policy is confirmed.

options.title: Require subscribed live proof
options.body: Pause acceptance until an authenticated OpenClaw-to-Claude-CLI Fable 5 agent turn verifies the complete provider route.

recommendation.title: Accept broad Fable support
recommendation.body: Repair the alias and merge this PR as the canonical Claude CLI Fable 5 catalog, setup, and context update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties Altay most directly to Claude CLI runtime and model-picker behavior. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101453))
